{{Infobox Slayer |name = Ghosts |skillreq = None |combatreq = {{SCP|Combat|13}} |otherreq = None |turael = 15-30 |spria = 15-30 |mazchna = 30-50 |id = No }} [[Ghost]]s can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] at level 13 [[combat]] by [[Turael]], [[Spria]], and [[Mazchna]]. Ghosts spawn in various locations throughout [[Gielinor]]. Only regular [[Ghost|ghosts]], [[Forgotten Soul|forgotten souls]], [[tortured soul]]s, [[death wing]]s and [[Revenants]] can be killed to satisfy the task. [[Spectres]], [[ghasts]], [[Banshee|banshees]] and [[shades]] will '''not''' count towards the task. Most areas that contain ghosts contain those of combat levels 19, 24, and 29. Ghosts with a combat level of 76 and 77 can only be found in the [[Sepulchre of Death]], the bottom floor of the [[Stronghold of Security]]. {{clear}} == Monster Variants == {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
